Name: reconstruction_pays_only_across_the_writer_gap
Title: Reconstruction Pays Only Across the Writer Gap: Reader-Side Rewriting of Foreign Experience Helps by Policy Distance, Not Writer Capability, at Matched Tokens
Short Hypothesis: Training-free read-time reconstruction (the reader rewrites the k=3 retrieved items into one plan in its own action grammar, conditioned on its first observation; the plan replaces the items) adds nothing over verbatim injection at k=7 (a comparator with at least the reconstruction arm's consumer tokens and more items) when the writer is the reader itself, and adds an increment of at least one third of the Gate-0 verbatim gain (about 6.5 net given the measured k7 - static3 = +19.5) when the writer is a different 32B backbone or the same backbone under a different action scaffold. The increment tracks writer-reader policy distance (different scaffold > temperature-only sampling from the same scaffold) and not writer capability (thinking mode under the same scaffold), survives length-matching of the banks, and is not reproduced by the same rewrite applied to the fixed static3 exemplars.
Related Work: MemHarness (2607.28272) shows critique-and-reconstruct beats verbatim replay, but the retrieved experience is the agent's own, the reconstruction policy is GRPO-trained (so the gain is not separated from training), and per-step token cost is not matched. Echo (2604.05533) adapts the agent's own Minecraft experience analogically; 2406.14596 abstracts sub-optimal demonstrations with human feedback; neither varies the writer. AdaCoM (2605.30785) finds that how much a frozen agent's context should be compressed depends on the agent's own baseline strength, but manages the agent's own trajectory, not another writer's experience, and reports no writer x reader cell. The cross-embodiment imitation literature (ImMimic 2509.10952, TrajSkill 2510.07773) translates demonstrations across a domain gap, which is the mechanism claimed here, but has no LLM-text analogue with the demonstrator manipulated at matched cost. Measurement C on this node (274 games x 2 seeds, paired with the k-sweep) gives the verbatim expert->Qwen3-32B result over the best static arm: k3 - static3 = +17.2 net [+11.9, +22.4], k7 - static3 = +19.5, look-at +4.8 with CI including 0; nothing on this node has measured any adaptation step. Archived closer_beats_stronger (5.75) claimed proximity predicts raw transfer without separating it from capability and without a self-pool control; archived abstraction_discards_bindings_and_repairs (5.95) varies abstraction level within one writer and holds the writer fixed.
Abstract: Adaptation methods for agent memory (reconstruction, analogical adaptation, abstraction) are validated only on experience the agent wrote itself, so it is unknown whether the adaptation step is a planning aid that helps regardless of who wrote the item or a translation step whose value depends on the writer. We manipulate the writer of an ALFWorld experience bank while holding the task set, bank construction, retriever and reader fixed: expert walkthroughs; the reader's own successes at matched collection cost; the same backbone under a different action scaffold at T=0 (phrasing distance at fixed capability); the same backbone at T=0.7 under the standard scaffold (sampling distance at fixed capability and phrasing); the same backbone in thinking mode under the standard scaffold (capability at fixed phrasing); and a second 32B backbone's successes. Two readers (Qwen3-32B, EXAONE-4.0-32B) read both backbones' banks with the roles of own and foreign reversed. Every gain is net of Measurement C's best static arm (static3; k7 - static3 = +19.5 net for the expert bank read by Qwen3-32B). For each writer x reader cell we compare training-free reconstruction at k=3 (one rewrite at step 0 of the three items into a plan in the reader's own action grammar, which replaces the items) against verbatim injection at k=7, a comparator with at least the reconstruction arm's consumer tokens and more items, and against the same rewrite applied to static3's fixed exemplars and to items retrieved for the wrong task type. The estimands are the reconstruction increment D over verbatim k=7 per cell and the retained-gain ratio before and after reconstruction, with cluster-bootstrap CIs over 274 games x 8 seeds for every cell that enters a prediction; the margin is pre-registered as the larger of one third of the Gate-0 verbatim gain and the realized half-width of the headline difference-of-differences, so every falsifier lies outside the noise. The central claim is an interaction: D is near zero for the self-written natural-length bank and exceeds it by the margin for the cross-backbone and different-scaffold banks, ordered by policy distance (scaffold > temperature-only) and not by writer capability (thinking mode), surviving length-matching and not reproduced by the placebo. A null or reversed interaction falsifies it; the natural-length self bank, whose wandering trajectories the rewrite can compress, the temperature-only bank and the thinking-mode bank can each produce that outcome. Consumer-side tokens and episodes per minute are reported with every gain.
Experiments:
- Banks (writers). All from the 3,553 train games (the 1,465 expert walkthroughs for W_exp), success-filtered, type-balanced to the expert pool's type distribution, at natural length (no cap) in the primary cells; length-capped copies (<= 2x the expert median steps) of the two headline banks are the mechanism ablation (P8). W_exp: expert walkthroughs (on disk). W_self: Qwen3-32B standard ReAct, non-thinking, T=0 (on disk). W_scaf: Qwen3-32B non-thinking, plan-then-act scaffold with different action phrasing, T=0 (collect, ~3 GPU-h). W_temp: Qwen3-32B non-thinking, standard scaffold, T=0.7 (collect, ~3 GPU-h). W_cap: Qwen3-32B thinking mode, standard scaffold, T=0 with a 2,048-token thinking cap (collect, ~8 GPU-h; if its k=0 success at T=0 is not >= 8 net above W_self, T=0.6 is used and W_temp serves as the temperature control). W_other: EXAONE-4.0-32B standard scaffold, T=0 (collect after serving verification, ~3 GPU-h). W_big is dropped. Bank verification before any confirmatory cell (274 games x 2 seeds at k=0 under the writer's own scaffold): W_scaf and W_temp within +/-5 net of W_self (fixed capability); W_cap >= +8 net above W_self (capability moved); policy distance to R1 = Jensen-Shannon divergence between the writer's and R1's action-template distributions (verb + argument pattern) over the same games, reported per bank, with the pre-registered ordering W_self < W_temp <= W_cap < W_scaf < W_other required to hold; if W_cap's divergence exceeds W_scaf's, P3 is reported as confounded rather than re-mapped.
- Readers: R1 Qwen3-32B standard non-thinking, T=0; R2 EXAONE-4.0-32B, T=0. Same retriever as Measurement C. R1's self-pool is W_self and R2's self-pool is W_other, each collected at the same episode budget as every foreign bank.
- Conditions: C0 no memory; C_static = static3 (Measurement C's best static arm: 3 fixed type-conditioned expert exemplars, ~430 tokens, cached); C_v3 verbatim k=3 (equal-items comparator; on disk for W_exp->R1); C_v7 verbatim k=7 (~1,010 injected tokens per step; the primary comparator, with at least the reconstruction arm's total consumer tokens and more items); C_r3 reconstruction k=3 (one rewrite call at step 0: task + first observation + the 3 items -> a plan of <= 300 tokens in the reader's own action grammar, which replaces the items in every later step; ~1k consumer tokens for the rewrite plus <= 300 per step); C_pl_static: the same rewrite prompt applied to static3's three fixed exemplars (memory-absent placebo, no retrieval); C_pl_mis: the same rewrite prompt applied to k=3 items retrieved for a different task type (mismatched placebo; also the manufactured wrong-item arm at rate 1.0; no detector is claimed). A 40-game pilot per reader logs total consumer tokens per episode for C_r3, C_v3 and C_v7; if C_r3 exceeds C_v7, k is raised until the verbatim arm has at least C_r3's tokens, and the matched k is reported.
- Estimands: reconstruction increment D(w,r) = S(r,C_r3,w) - S(r,C_v7,w); verbatim retained-gain ratio rho_v(w,r) = [S(r,C_v7,w) - S(r,static3)] / [S(r,C_v7,selfpool(r)) - S(r,static3)] and rho_r(w,r) with C_r3 in the numerator over the same denominator (so rho_r - rho_v = D divided by the self-pool gain; rho_v(W_self,R1) = 1 by construction); all with cluster-bootstrap CIs; per-type breakdown (exploratory); consumer tokens per episode (prompt + generated, including the rewrite call) and episodes/min per cell.
- Margin: M = max(G0/3, h_DiD), where G0 = S(R1,C_v7,W_far) - S(R1,static3) for the headline foreign bank W_far and h_DiD = the realized 95% cluster-bootstrap half-width of the headline difference-of-differences at 8 seeds (expected ~5.7 net if noise scales as 1/sqrt(seeds) from the +/-8 at 2 seeds; if h_DiD > 7 the four P1 cells are extended to 12 seeds before the test). M_R2 is defined the same way from R2's Gate-0 gain S(R2,C_v7,W_self) - S(R2,static3).
- Gate 0 (before confirmatory cells): (a) W_far = W_other if S(R1,C_v7,W_other) - S(R1,static3) >= +12 net with CI excluding 0 at the first 4 of the 8 seeds; otherwise W_far = W_exp (measured +19.5, so M = 6.5) and the cross-backbone headline is reported as unsupported; (b) C_r3 on (W_exp,R1) at 2 seeds is not below C_v7 by more than the 2-seed half-width (a broken rewrite prompt shows as a large drop); (c) the pilot token match above.
- Cells (274 games each; 8 seeds = 2,192 episodes unless stated). R1: static3 (2 Measurement-C seeds reused + 6 new, 1,644), C_pl_static, C_pl_mis, {W_self, W_other, W_scaf, W_temp, W_cap, W_exp} x {C_v7, C_r3} (12 cells; W_exp C_v7 reuses its 2 seeds), {W_self^cap, W_other^cap} x {C_v7, C_r3} (4 cells; if W_far = W_exp only W_self^cap is built, since the expert bank is already at the cap): 19 cells, ~40k episodes. R2: static3, {W_self, W_other} x {C_v7, C_r3} (5 cells, ~11k), W_exp x {C_v7, C_r3} at 4 seeds (2.2k), C0 at 2 seeds (0.5k): ~13.7k. Ablations on (W_far,R1) at 4 seeds: reconstruct-every-5-steps, provenance revealed (2.2k). Bank verification k=0 runs: 3 x 548 = 1.6k. Total ~58k episodes plus ~17 GPU-h of bank collection. Throughput: ~20 episodes/min per replica for verbatim, ~12-15 for reconstruction, blended ~15/min/replica: 58k / 15 = ~64 replica-hours, plus 17 GPU-h of collection = ~81 GPU-h over two A100s = ~41 h of wall time (one A100 serves R1 throughout while the other collects the four banks and then serves R2 and the remaining R1 cells); ~2.5 days with the pilot and re-runs.
Baselines and Ablations:
- Cheapest baseline first: static3 (Measurement C) and the reconstruction placebo on static3, both before any retrieval cell.
- Primary comparator for every reconstruction cell: direct injection of the unmodified items at k=7 (C_v7), which has at least the reconstruction arm's total consumer tokens (pilot-verified; k raised if not) and more items, and which Measurement C shows is the stronger verbatim arm (+19.5 vs +17.2 over static3); C_v3 is the equal-items comparator (on disk for W_exp->R1).
- Self-pool control at matched collection cost: W_self for R1 and W_other for R2, collected at the same episode budget as every foreign bank; every foreign-bank gain and increment is reported against that cell, and rho_v, rho_r use it as the denominator.
- Placebos: C_pl_static (memory-absent), C_pl_mis (mismatched; also the manufactured wrong-item arm at rate 1.0, no detector claimed).
- Ablations: length-capped copies of the two headline banks (P8, 8 seeds); reconstruct-every-5-steps on (W_far,R1) at 4 seeds (does state-conditioning beyond step 0 add anything at its token cost); writer identity revealed vs hidden in the rewrite prompt on (W_far,R1) at 4 seeds (does the reader use provenance); thinking-mode bank at T=0.6 if the T=0 collection fails verification, with W_temp as its temperature control.
- Named reimplementation: MemHarness-style critique-and-reconstruct prompt without RL (2607.28272) as C_r3; the GRPO-trained version is out of budget and is named as the untested arm.
Falsifiable Predictions:
- P1 (headline interaction): D(W_far,R1) - D(W_self,R1) >= M with a 95% cluster-bootstrap CI excluding 0 (M >= h_DiD by construction, so the predicted effect lies outside the noise). Falsifier: the CI includes 0 or the point estimate is negative, i.e. reconstruction helps the reader's own natural-length bank as much as or more than the foreign bank. Arm: {W_self, W_far} x {C_v7, C_r3} for R1 at 8 seeds; the self cell can produce a large D because the natural-length self bank contains wandering on-policy trajectories that the rewrite can compress into a short plan (the length cap that would remove this route is now only the P8 ablation).
- P2 (proximity at fixed capability): D(W_scaf,R1) - D(W_self,R1) >= M with CI excluding 0. Falsifier: CI includes 0 or negative (a different action scaffold from the same backbone at the same k=0 success gains nothing from translation). Arm: {W_scaf, W_self} x {C_v7, C_r3} for R1 at 8 seeds, with W_scaf verified within +/-5 net of W_self at k=0.
- P3 (capability at fixed proximity): D(W_scaf,R1) - D(W_cap,R1) >= M with CI excluding 0 (the primary test; it does not use the W_self cell), and, as an equivalence statement, the 90% CI of D(W_cap,R1) - D(W_self,R1) lies within [-M, +M] (TOST; a CI that straddles +M is reported as inconclusive, a distinct outcome). Falsifier: D(W_scaf) - D(W_cap) has a CI including 0 or negative (the thinking-mode bank gains as much from rewriting as the different-scaffold bank: capability distance governs), or the 90% CI of D(W_cap) - D(W_self) extends beyond +M. Arm: {W_cap, W_scaf, W_self} x {C_v7, C_r3} for R1 at 8 seeds, with W_cap verified >= +8 net above W_self at k=0 and with divergence to R1 not above W_scaf's.
- P4 (format distance, not trajectory diversity): D(W_scaf,R1) - D(W_temp,R1) >= M with CI excluding 0. Falsifier: CI includes 0 or negative (the temperature-only bank, same phrasing but more diverse and longer trajectories, gains as much: the increment tracks what rewriting compresses, not what it translates). Arm: {W_scaf, W_temp} x {C_v7, C_r3} for R1 at 8 seeds.
- P5 (token-matched, absolute): S(C_r3) - S(C_v7) >= M with CI excluding 0 in the cell (W_other,R1) and >= M_R2 with CI excluding 0 in the cell (W_self,R2). Falsifier: the CI includes 0 or is negative in either cell (seven verbatim foreign items at greater token cost do as well as three rewritten ones). Arm: those four cells at 8 seeds; Measurement C shows k7 is not harmed relative to k3 for R1, so the comparator is a strong one.
- P6 (placebo, absolute): D(W_far,R1) - [S(R1,C_pl_static) - S(R1,static3)] >= M with CI excluding 0, tested only if S(R1,C_r3,W_far) - S(R1,C_v7,W_far) has a CI excluding 0; and S(R1,C_pl_mis) - S(R1,static3) has a 95% CI upper bound below M. Falsifier: the placebo difference-of-differences has a CI including 0 (rewriting fixed exemplars into a plan captures the increment: it is a planning step, not adaptation of the foreign item), or the mismatched rewrite gains >= M (rewriting anything helps). Arm: C_pl_static, C_pl_mis, static3 and the W_far cells for R1 at 8 seeds.
- P7 (symmetry across the store): D(W_self,R2) - D(W_other,R2) >= M_R2 with CI excluding 0, i.e. the same two banks with the roles of foreign and own reversed for EXAONE. Falsifier: CI includes 0 or negative (rewriting does not help EXAONE read Qwen3's experience more than it helps it read its own). Arm: {W_self, W_other} x {C_v7, C_r3} for R2 at 8 seeds, with R2's own static3 and self-pool cells.
- P8 (translation, not compression): with both headline banks capped at 2x the expert median length, D(W_far^cap,R1) - D(W_self^cap,R1) >= M with CI excluding 0. Falsifier: the capped CI includes 0 while the uncapped P1 contrast excluded it (the P1 increment was compression of long foreign items). Arm: {W_self^cap, W_far^cap} x {C_v7, C_r3} for R1 at 8 seeds.
Measurement and Noise Control: Paired per-game success differences on the 274 evaluation games (seen + unseen, as in Measurement C) with seeds nested in games; cluster bootstrap over games (2,000 resamples) for every estimand, every difference-of-differences and every ratio. Seeds: 8 for every cell that enters P1-P8 (paired half-width ~+/-4 net for a single difference and ~+/-5.7 for a difference of two paired differences if noise scales as 1/sqrt(seeds) from the measured +/-8 at 274 x 2). The realized half-widths are computed first and M = max(G0/3, h_DiD) is set from them, so no prediction's margin can sit inside its own CI; if h_DiD at 8 seeds exceeds 7 net the four P1 cells go to 12 seeds, and if it still exceeds 8 the interaction is reported as underpowered and the absolute per-cell increments (P5) are the reportable result. Screening and exploratory cells ((W_exp,R2), C0 for R2, bank verification, the two 4-seed ablations) at 2-4 seeds (+/-8 to +/-5.7). One pre-registered headline contrast (P1); P2-P8 secondary, reported with unadjusted CIs and a Holm-adjusted summary; per-type breakdowns exploratory only (a ~45-game type cell has a half-width ~2.5x the pooled one and supports no claim). Margins are fractions of the measured Gate-0 gain (k7 - static3 = +19.5 for the expert bank; W_other's gain measured in Gate 0), never fixed numbers. Consumer-side tokens (prompt and generated, including the rewrite call) and episodes/min are logged per episode and reported per cell, so every increment carries its token cost. Readers run at temperature 0; writers at the temperature their manipulation specifies; seeds fix the environment split and sampling. All runs under nohup with pid files and append-only JSONL, workers tuned to the vLLM running queue (>= 8 per replica), one replica per A100, both GPUs busy throughout.
Preprint Collision Check: All queries ran through tools/ideate2/s2cli.py (Semantic Scholar + HF Papers, channel s2=ok hf=ok unless noted). (1) recent: 'reconstruct retrieved experience conditioned on current state agent cross-model transfer' -> MemHarness 2607.28272, 2608.26730 (conditional reuse of update evidence in post-training), 2607.13884 Experience Memory Graph, 2606.00547, Echo 2604.05533; none manipulates the writer of the retrieved experience or matches tokens. (2) closest named method: 'MemHarness critique and reconstruct retrieved experience negative transfer verbatim replay' -> 2607.28272, 2604.27003 (memory design trades transfer against forgetting at the retrieval level), otherwise continual-learning replay papers; no writer x reader cell. (3) home: 'cross-domain imitation learning demonstration translation embodiment mismatch' -> ImMimic 2509.10952, TrajSkill 2510.07773, UniSkill 2505.08787, H2R-Bench 2608.13049: demonstration translation across a domain gap is an established mechanism in robotics; no text-experience analogue, no demonstrator manipulation at matched cost. (4) recent: 'context augmentation model execution feedback transfer to different execution agent backbone' -> AdaCoM 2605.30785 (verified with s2cli paper: compression level should depend on the agent's own baseline strength, agent's own context only), CLEAR 2604.07487, HarnessDev 2609.01437 (self-built harnesses transfer poorly across models). Nearest pre-emption is AdaCoM's reader-strength dependence; it does not vary the writer and does not compare against verbatim injection at matched tokens. No result found that reports the adaptation increment as a function of writer identity.
Risk Factors and Limitations: Ceiling: verbatim expert items give R1 ~0.81/0.87 success at k=3 and k7 - static3 = +19.5, leaving 13-19 net of headroom for reconstruction on W_exp; the headline therefore rests on W_other (Gate 0 requires its verbatim k=7 gain net of static3 to be >= +12 with CI excluding 0), with W_exp as the pre-registered fallback whose ceiling then bounds the increment and is reported as such. If EXAONE-4.0-32B does not serve in vLLM 0.13, W_other, R2, P5's second cell and P7 are dropped; W_scaf, W_temp and W_cap still give the proximity-vs-capability contrasts within one backbone with W_exp as the far bank, and the cross-backbone claim is reported as untested. Natural-length banks make writer identity partly a length manipulation; P8 (length-capped copies of both headline banks at 8 seeds) separates translation from compression, and bank length distributions are reported. The policy-distance measure (action-template divergence) is coarse and ALFWorld's six procedures make 'policy distance' mostly scaffold and phrasing distance; if W_cap's measured divergence exceeds W_scaf's, P3 is reported as confounded. Thinking-mode collection is slow (~8 GPU-h) and at T=0 may loop; the thinking cap, the success filter and the k=0 verification handle this, and the T=0.6 fallback is controlled by W_temp. The rewrite replaces the items, so C_r3 has fewer per-step tokens than C_v7 and the comparison is conservative against reconstruction; a positive D at lower per-token cost is the useful outcome, while a positive D with worse per-token efficiency than C_v7 reverses the practical recommendation and is reported as such. Reconstruction lowers throughput (~12-15 episodes/min per replica vs ~20). The 1/sqrt(seeds) scaling of the half-width assumes homogeneous per-game effects; the adaptive M and the 12-seed extension guard against its failure. The TOST clause of P3 has a wide inconclusive zone at 8 seeds (|point estimate| must be <= ~1.7 net to pass), which is why the direct contrast is the primary test. A WebShop replication is out of budget.
Addresses gap: G16 (adaptation validated only on self-written experience) as the primary target; G20 (adaptation cost never matched against plain retrieval) through the C_v7 comparator that has at least the reconstruction arm's consumer tokens and the per-cell token and throughput reporting; G18 partially through the retained-gain ratio before and after reconstruction with the self-pool denominator.
Not a restatement of: Brief bullet: Measurement C (expert->Qwen3-32B verbatim over the best static arm, k3 - static3 = +17.2 net [+11.9, +22.4], k7 - static3 = +19.5, look-at +4.8 with CI including 0) measures verbatim injection only; this idea claims the increment of a reconstruction step over that verbatim k=7 result and that the increment depends on who wrote the item, which C cannot show because it has one writer and no adaptation arm. Digest card: 2607.28272 MemHarness claims reconstruction beats replay for the agent's own experience with a GRPO-trained policy; this idea claims that training-free reconstruction adds nothing for self-written items and gains only across a writer gap against a verbatim comparator with more items and at least as many tokens, net of a planning placebo, a claim MemHarness never tests because its writer is always the reader. Archived: abstraction_discards_bindings_and_repairs varies abstraction within one writer at fixed reader; here abstraction is fixed (raw items) and the writer is the manipulated variable with proximity (scaffold, temperature) and capability (thinking mode) separated within one backbone, which closer_beats_stronger did not do.
Changes made:
- Static baseline updated to Measurement C's static3 (k3 - static3 = +17.2, k7 - static3 = +19.5); all gains are net of it; C_pl_static now rewrites static3's three fixed exemplars.
- Margin and power (all six flags): M = max(G0/3, realized DiD half-width) with every cell entering a prediction at 8 seeds (12 if h_DiD > 7), so no margin lies inside its own CI; Gate 0 requires W_other's verbatim k=7 gain >= +12 net (else W_exp, measured +19.5, M = 6.5).
- P1: uses D rather than D* (the placebo term cancels across writers read by the same reader); primary banks at natural length so the self-bank compression route that falsifies P1 is reachable; W_far pre-registered with a fallback.
- P2/P3/P4: W_prox split into W_scaf (scaffold, T=0) and W_temp (T=0.7, standard scaffold), separating phrasing from temperature; the capability clause is now a direct contrast D(W_scaf) - D(W_cap) with its own CI (no shared W_self term) plus a TOST equivalence bound with an explicit inconclusive outcome; new P4 predicts format distance beats sampling distance, a risky and reachable falsifier; a measured action-template divergence orders the banks before the confirmatory cells.
- Old P3 -> P5: margin M (>= half-width) and CI excluding 0 in two symmetric cross-backbone cells at 8 seeds; (W_exp,R2) demoted to exploratory at 4 seeds.
- Old P4 -> P6: placebo restated as an absolute difference-of-differences with its own CI, conditioned on the increment's CI excluding 0; mismatched placebo bounded in net points.
- Old P5 -> P7: the rho contrast (an identity up to a shared denominator) replaced by the mirror interaction for R2 (own vs foreign) at 8 seeds against C_v7, not C_v3; rho_v and rho_r now use the self-pool denominator (no writer-as-reader cells) and are reported, not tested.
- Old P6 (look-at-in-light) removed: Measurement C gives look-at +4.8 with CI including 0, so the 'verbatim is negative' premise is gone and a ~45-game cell cannot support a claim; replaced by P8, the length-capped mechanism ablation at 8 seeds.
- Budget: W_big dropped, C_v3 cells dropped except on-disk ones, cell-by-cell counts given (~58k episodes, ~17 GPU-h collection, ~41 h on two A100s, ~2.5 days).
- Sharpness kept: the central interaction, the proximity-not-capability ordering and the absolute increment are all still stated as effects of at least one third of the measured verbatim gain against the stronger k=7 comparator; the self-bank falsifier was made easier to reach (natural length), not harder, and P4 and P8 add two new ways for the claim to fail.
